data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a GBP 8.7 million release of gross technical reserves in 2015, primarily attributable to favorable development in prior periods, particularly within the fire and other damage to property line of business. This release represents a 24.7% reduction relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. Specific events from the 2013 underwriting year, including the withdrawal of some notifications and the non-requirement of a GBP 1.4 million reserve for a material damage loss in China, contributed to this favorable development, despite other paid losses from a medical isotope plant in South Africa (GBP 1.7m) and a fuel fabrication plant in the UK (GBP 1.5m).
